scope.method: Individually reviewed each candidate or unresolved record. Original abstracts/metadata refreshed; direct original full-text access attempted for every record; accessible methods/tables/figure captions reviewed. Selected original/institutional/registry routes followed for eligibility and overlap. Full text unavailable and missing eligibility kept distinct. Not a systematic full-text exhaustive retrieval or human dual review.
scope.primary_definition: Eligible adult T1D kinetic evidence group, possibly limited to specified separable controls; does not mean full text accessible, U100-only, independent cohort or valid numerical reference.
scope.background_definition: Useful indirect/mixed-population or model ancestry; no eligible direct plasma-lispro kinetic target established.
scope.unresolved_definition: Potentially eligible but population, formulation, separability or accessible evidence insufficient; not counted primary.
scope.download_note: Public original/source snapshots retained under ignored results/lit001/source-material/a/ with URL/hash manifest; no raw patient dataset acquired and no blanket redistribution license asserted. HTTP200 checked for article versus redirect/challenge content. Wilinska journal PDF retained separately by parent.
scope.exposure_note: All source content read here is exposed evidence and cannot subsequently be labelled unseen validation; independent human review unclaimed.

decisions.reason: Thesis supports model ancestry. Chapter 4 is adult T1D but its absorption parameter is fitted to glucose, not plasma insulin; Chapter 5 is a direct lispro kinetic study with unresolved all-adult eligibility.
measurements_and_conditions: Chapter 4 printed pp51–64 (PDF65–78): 12 T1D participants aged21–64; Humalog CSII and meal boluses; plasma insulin sampled every30min. Concentration not located.

Chapter 4 pp56–60: three-compartment insulin equations; ke=0.1408/min and Vi=0.12L/kg fixed fromref91. Plasma glucose is fitted output. Table4.4 p64 reports individual ka in 10^-2/min; visually checked.
Chapter 5 pp75–93: seven T1D participants, mean age31.7±14.1 without range. Ten competing models, Model9 selected; distinct manuscript stage from 2005 journal eleven-model account.
decisions.reference_feasibility: Declared-model reconstruction possible after unit/source audit; patient-curve reproduction lacks numeric pump histories. Adult chapter4 is not independent plasma-PK validation.
decisions.overlap_and_independence: Chapter5 matches seven-person Graz journal2005 cohort by protocol/demographics; do not count twice. Chapter4 has a separate12-person protocol, but participant overlap with other Graz publications is unestablished.
